name: Destruction in Deadmines
summary: In Westfall, Alba Fairmoon sends an operative to destroy the Defias forge in the Deadmines. The explosives are already planted, and Alba waits in the hills behind Moonbrook for the detonator.

sections.title: Sabotage Beneath Westfall
sections.body: The Deadmines hold the Defias Brotherhood's strength beneath Westfall. Alba Fairmoon directs you to sabotage the forge hidden in the mines. The explosives are already planted beside it, and you return to Alba in the hills behind Moonbrook to set them off from a safe distance. She hopes destroying the forge will let Westfall's poisoned land begin to heal.

sections.title: The Detonator
sections.body: The charge sits beside the forge deep in the Deadmines. A remote detonator lets you set it off from outside the caves, after you rejoin Alba Fairmoon in the hills behind Moonbrook. She hopes that with the forge destroyed, Westfall's poisoned land can begin to heal.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Destruction in Deadmines?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon, an operative in Westfall, gives you the assignment and directs you against the Defias Brotherhood's stronghold.

faq.q: What is the primary objective of this mission?
aliases: what do i do in destruction in deadmines
how to complete destruction in deadmines
faq.answer: You set off the explosives planted beside the Defias forge in the Deadmines, using the detonator from outside the mines after rejoining Alba Fairmoon.

faq.q: Why target the Deadmines with explosives?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon traced the poison in Westfall's farmland to a large metallurgical forge hidden in the Deadmines. She hopes destroying it will let the land begin to heal.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You return to Alba Fairmoon in the hills behind Moonbrook, outside the Deadmines, after the explosives are planted.

faq.q: Is this mission available to Horde players?
aliases: is destruction in deadmines alliance only
can horde do destruction in deadmines
faq.answer: No. Alba Fairmoon works with Alliance operatives defending Westfall against the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What threat does the Defias Brotherhood pose in Westfall?
aliases: what are defias doing in deadmines
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood drove out farmers, raided settlements, and seized Westfall's abandoned mines. From deep in the Deadmines, they are building an armed insurrection that threatens the kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: The assignment centers on demolition and remotely triggered detonators, a craft that may appeal to engineers.
You infiltrate enemy territory, plant charges, and slip away before the blast in this act of covert sabotage.
As an Alliance member, every blow against the Defias stronghold helps safeguard Westfall's struggling farmsteads and Stormwind's southern border.
